items.title: 17.7.2 Choone ke pathar se quicklime (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the production of quicklime (PDF 13).

blocks.text: Choone ke pathar (calcium carbonate) se quicklime (calcium oxide) banana qadeem tareen aur bunyadi sanati amal mein se hai. Quicklime tameer (cement, mortar), zaraat (mitti ka ilaaj), dhaat kaari aur bohat si kimiyai sanaton mein zaroori hai. Choone ka pathar wafir sedimentary chattan hai jo zyada tar calcium carbonate se bana hai.

blocks.alt: Tukron se bhari oonchi bhatti: oopar se kuta hua choone ka pathar (CaCO3) dala jata, koyle aur qudrati gas ke jalne ki garam gases pehlu se neeche dakhil hoti, carbon dioxide oopar se nikalti aur neeche se quicklime (CaO) nikalta hai. Dabba 900-1000 C par ulat jane wala reaction deta hai.
blocks.caption: Lime kiln (Figure 17.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Quicklime choone ke pathar (calcium carbonate) ko lime kiln mein taqreeban 900-1000 C tak garam kar ke banta hai, yeh thermal decomposition calcination kehlata hai: CaCO3(s) <=> CaO(s) + CO2(g). Jadeed bhatti mein maal ghoomti garam gases se garam hota hai. Band bartan mein reaction ulat sakta hai, is liye carbon dioxide musalsal nikali jati hai; is se equilibrium daen taraf jata aur quicklime ki bari miqdar milti hai.

blocks.text: Choone ka pathar lime kiln mein taqreeban 900-1000 C tak garam kiya jata hai, yeh thermal decomposition calcination kehlata hai: garam karne par CaCO3(s) -> CaO(s) + CO2(g). Jadeed bhattiyon mein maal ghoomti garam gases se garam hota hai. Band bartan mein reaction ulat sakta hai, is liye carbon dioxide musalsal nikali jati hai; is se equilibrium daen taraf jata aur zyada maal milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Lime kiln se carbon dioxide musalsal kyun nikali jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Maal (product) nikalne se equilibrium CaCO3 <=> CaO + CO2 daen taraf jata hai, is liye zyada choone ka pathar tootta aur zyada quicklime milta hai.

items: CO2 nikalne se reaction daen taraf.
